text: 8 points Suppose Carol and Bob get together to write a sorting algorithm, but they don’t agree on how to implement things. Carol decides to implement Bubble sort where each pass of the algorithm goes fromi = 1 t0 4 = n. Bob likes his Bubble sort to perform the passes from i = n to i = 1. They decide to compromise and write a Carol-Bob-Sort as follows: they implement Bubble-sort so that at the first pass is from i = 1 to i=n and the second pass is from i = n to i = 1, alternating directions at each pass. As usual, the bubble sort algorithm will terminate when a pass completes that carries out no swaps. Determine the best-case and worst-case number of swaps in this algorithm.
